items.exampleEn: Be careful; there are glass fragments on the floor.
Birds can fly freely in the sky.
items.exampleZh: 鳥可以在天空中自由地飛翔。

items.exampleEn: The town was severely short of water last summer.
items.exampleZh: 去年夏天鎮上嚴重缺水。

items.exampleEn: The instructions were too vague to follow.
items.exampleZh: 說明太含糊了，根本沒辦法照著做。

items.exampleEn: The door handle is made of brass.
Asking for money is always a little awkward.
items.exampleZh: 開口要錢總是有點尷尬。

items.sentenceEn: The ending of the game was stunning.
items.sentenceZh: 那場比賽的結局令人驚嘆。

items.audioEn: Our team won a bronze medal, which means we came third.
items.audioZh: 我們隊得了銅牌，也就是第三名。
options: Third place, with a bronze medal.

items.sentenceEn: He was severely punished for lying.
items.sentenceZh: 他因為說謊而受到嚴厲處罰。

items.sentenceEn: The old brass bell still rings every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 那個舊黃銅鐘每天早上還是會響。

items.stemEn: I only have a ____ memory of my first house; I was very young then.
items.stemZh: 我對第一個家只有模糊的記憶，那時我還很小。

items.stemEn: The view of the mountains at sunrise was absolutely ____.
items.stemZh: 日出時的山景真是美得驚人。

items.passageEn: Last week, our class visited the city museum. In the first room, there was a stunning bronze statue of a horse. Next to it were some fragments of old pots. When we asked the guide how old they were, she gave a vague answer. In another room, there were brass instruments from long ago, and visitors could touch them freely. One of them was severely damaged, so it was kept behind glass. My friend tried to play a trumpet and made a very loud, strange sound. It was an awkward moment, but then everyone laughed.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們班參觀了市立博物館。在第一間展覽室裡，有一座美得驚人的青銅馬雕像。旁邊有一些古老陶罐的碎片。我們問導覽員那些碎片有多老時，她給了一個含糊的回答。另一間展覽室裡，有很久以前的銅管樂器，遊客可以自由地觸摸。其中一件樂器嚴重損壞，所以被放在玻璃後面。我的朋友試著吹小號，結果發出一個又大又怪的聲音。那一刻很尷尬，但接著大家都笑了。

questions.questionZh: 第一間展覽室裡有什麼？
為什麼有一件樂器放在玻璃後面？
options: 因為它是國王送的禮物

items.promptZh: 他對我的問題回答得很含糊。
referenceEn: His answer to my question was vague.
He gave a vague answer to my question.
rubricZh: vague 表示「含糊的」，例如 a vague answer 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 awkward 造一個句子，說說一個讓你覺得尷尬的時刻。
referenceEn: I felt awkward when I forgot my friend's name.
It was awkward when my phone rang during the test.
rubricZh: awkward 表示「尷尬的」，例如 feel awkward 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）
